title: Secure the installation location against unauthorised access
body_md: Select an installation location that is adequately secured against unauthorised access but still accessible for service work, for example a later SIM card replacement.
prev_context: The scope of supply ends on the previous page.
next_context: The requirement to install inside the vehicle follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 7: equivalent in substance. Neither version states a criterion for when a location counts as adequately secured.
